purpose: Abstract sculpture assembled from individual planar panes; concept only
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / product-mockup. The attached image is the edit target and reference for motif, three-view presentation and warm amber/cream/cocoa palette. Redesign this Corgi sculpture lamp into bold geometric art assembled EXCLUSIVELY from RIGID FLAT PLANAR PANES. Keep three views of ONE consistent identical sculpture (front three-quarter left, side profile middle, rear three-quarter right), low opaque black pedestal, neutral charcoal background, hidden internal warm lighting, long muzzle, large upright ears and attentive gentle expression. Change the GEOMETRY radically to an elegant faceted polyhedron: straight edges, crisp angular silhouette, broad true flat triangular and quadrilateral faces, visibly sharp dihedral folds between panes. Approximately 35 to 45 panes in TOTAL over the entire sculpture, not per view; generous broad pieces rather than dense triangulation. Each colored pane is one physically FLAT piece that could be printed lying on a bed and inserted into a black structural edge frame at an angle to its neighbors. Absolutely no bulging, doming, curved panels, sweeping curved glass, rounded contours, carved fur or sculpted nostrils. The volume is entirely made by assembling planes. Outer ear shapes are triangular prism wedges with one large champagne triangular inner-ear face each; skull is polygonal; long muzzle is a tapered box/prism with cream flat top and sides and a single dark flat polygon nose cap; cheeks are broad amber planes; eyes are simple flat dark polygon inlays with one small restrained white highlight, not rounded realistic eyeballs; chest is two or three broad milky-white trapezoid planes; rear neck is a few broad opaque cocoa planes. Retain a soft appealing upward gaze through placement of the angular eyes and head tilt. Abstract art and a recognizable Corgi mix, not realism. Restrained matte black ribs of consistent approximately 2mm apparent width follow all straight pane seams; clean substantial corner joints. Flat translucent satin PLA panes with subtle uniform fine print lines, avoid fake cracked glass or stone textures. Warm light comes through gold/champagne/white planes only, black ribs/nose/base and dark brown remain opaque, no bare source, no seam leaks, no light ring around base. The black pedestal may be a shallow faceted oval plinth with flat chamfers. This is a concept visualization, not a validated mesh. No text, no dimensions, no logos, no watermarks. Ensure the SIDE and REAR views are just as angular and planar as the front. No flat picture frames or portrait panels: whole object remains a freestanding 3D sculpture in the round.
